name: Grimtotem Marauders pull a same-level player from 10 yd like other starting-zone hostiles
contract: Starting-zone hostiles such as the Bristleback Quilboar detect a same-level player at 10 yd. The Three
Totems Grimtotems kept the 20 yd default, and rev_20261004_50_coa_grimtotem_aggro_range sets them to 10.
Expected: an aggressive Grimtotem Marauder 161809 of the player's level leaves a player standing 15 yd away
out of combat and attacks once the player steps to 6 yd.
